analysis:
This PR changes documentation only: docs/developer/test.md (date stamp, head text only), docs/provider/direct-mode.md (new 'Experimental Nemotron Super owner fixtures' section at head lines 176-210) and docs/provider/hardware-requirements.md (date stamp plus a note that Nemotron Super VL has no qualified RAM-tier or serving recommendation). No source, auth, attestation or crypto code is changed.

Security-relevant claims in the docs: the optional NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP hook is stated to be absent by default, to have no production callsite and not to advertise a model. It reuses the existing local auth, body limits and cancellation scope. It has 429 concurrency limiting, refuses image input while MTP is installed, and returns 400 on invalid controls. The doc also states that cancellation must retain media/KV ownership until native terminal retirement. These touch TB-003/TB-007 and A-001 (local plaintext prompts and images). The direct-mode local endpoint remains outside coordinator, E2E and attestation boundaries, and loopback is the default bind. Nothing in the PR alters T-041 (prefix cache), T-050 (video temp files), T-053, T-054 or the TB-011 authorization.

Coverage limit: the hook implementation (NemotronSuperLocalImageHTTP.swift) is not in this PR, so the described behaviors (default-absent, no production callsite, drain ordering, media memory release on cancel) are unverified. A later source PR that installs the hook needs review for image-decoding limits, media temp-file handling (T-050), cache-salt scoping and KV residue (T-028, T-041). No threat-model update is required for this docs-only change.
